idleGreeting.text: I'm here! I'll pipe up when something needs your attention, or tap me any time for a pointer.

tip1.text: Password and OTP live in your account settings, not here - I'm a snail-phone, not a locksmith.

tip2.text: Your session renews itself while you work. If it ever sinks, we chart you straight back to the login page.

tip1.text: An expired invitation isn't lost at sea - resend it and the clock resets to seven days.

tip2.text: Grant a role now? The crewmate sees it shortly, not instantly - even gull-mail takes its time.

tip3.text: The last ADMIN is protected - a ship with no captain just drifts in circles.

tip1.text: A permission with nobody holding it is dead weight - delete it, or grant it to a role from the matrix.

tip2.text: Groups collapse by default so the list stays readable - click one open to see what it guards.

tip3.text: At least one role must always hold roles:manage, or nobody's left who can fix the crew's roster.

tip1.text: The ship's log is never erased. Not even the sharpest first mate can rewrite a route already sailed.

tip2.text: Here you see who did what, and when - handy when someone swears they never touched a thing.

users.title: Crew Manifest

users.rolesPermissionsHint: Menus, chips, filters and actions all read this list — a new role, or finer-grained permissions, arrive without redrawing anything.
users.goldenRule1: The last active ADMIN can never be revoked or demoted — the ship doesn't sail without a captain.
users.goldenRule2: Roles and status changed by an admin aren't instant for the other user — they take effect shortly, not immediately.

roles.title: Roles & Permissions

roles.deleteRoleHint: A role with no crew, and not the last one holding roles:manage, deletes right away.
